{White's d5-d6 advance was premature. How should Black prepare to win the
overextended pawn?} 4... Ne4 {[%wrong There's a better attacking option. Try
again and look for a good way to attack the d6-pawn.] [%hint Centralize a
piece and attack d6.]} (4... Qb6 $5 {This is a good choice, but it's even
stronger to attack d6 with a knight. How can you do that?}) (4... Qa5+ $2 5.
Nc3 {White develops and keeps the d6-pawn. Try again and look for a good move
to target d6.}) (4... g6 $2 5. Nc3 {It's better to target the d6-pawn with
another piece. How should you do it?}) 5. Bf4 {Great start! How should you
take advantage of the exposed bishop on f4?} Qf6 {[%wrong There's a better
attacking option. Try again and look for the best move to target the f4-bishop.
] [%hint Develop to fork f4 and b2.]} (5... Qa5+ $5 {This is a good move, but
there's an even better square for the queen. Try to find it.}) (5... Qb6 $5 6.
Nc3 {Black is doing well, but there's a better square for the queen. Try to
find it.}) (5... Nc6 $5 {This is a good move, but it's best to develop and
attack the f4-bishop. How should you do it?}) (5... Qh4 $2 6. g3 {The queen
must retreat. Try again and look for a better queen move.}) (5... g5 $2 6. Be5
{Black is doing well, but it's stronger to develop a piece to attack the
bishop. How should you do it?}) 6. Qc1 {Good choice! How should Black win a
pawn?} Bxd6 {[%wrong There's a stronger move. Try again and look for the best
capture.] [%hint Develop a piece and capture a pawn.] Good work! Black has an
extra pawn and a great position.} (6... Nxf2 $5 {This is a good option, but
it's simpler to capture a pawn while you develop a piece. How should you do it?
}) (6... Nxd6 $2 7. Nc3 {Black is doing well, but it's stronger to develop
while capturing a pawn. How should you do it?}) *

capture a piece.] Nice job! White can capture on d6 next, but the powerful
dark square bishop and the safer king give Black a good game.} (13... Bxh6 $2

stronger capture.}) *

{How did GM Korobov maneuver his d2-knight to take advantage of weaknesses on
the black kingside?} 13. Nf1 {[%wrong There's a better option. Try to find a
good move with your d2-knight.] [%hint Retreat the d2-knight so that it can
soon reach the useful g3-square.]} (13. h3 $2 a6 {Black has a comfortable
position. Try again and look for a good move with the d2-knight.}) (13. Nc4 $2
Nxc4 {It's better for the knight to head toward the kingside. Try to find a
stronger square for it.}) (13. Nf3 $2 Nxf3+ {There's no need to trade knights.
Try to find a better kingside path for this knight.}) (13. Ndb1 $2 Nfd7 {
It's better for the knight to head toward the kingside. Try to find a stronger
square for it.}) (13. Nb3 $6 h6 {It's better for the knight to head toward the
kingside. Try to find a stronger square for it.}) 13... h6 {Great start! Where
should the knight head next?} 14. Ng3 {[%wrong There's a better move. Try to
find a good square for your f1-knight.] [%hint Control f5 and h5 with your
knight.] Well played! The knight dominates weak squares in the black kingside

reasonable, but GM Korobov preferred to continue to maneuver the f1-knight.
Where should it head next?}) (14. Qc2 $5 {This is reasonable, but GM Korobov
preferred to continue to maneuver the f1-knight. Where should it head next?}) (
